9. A decisive smaller experiment

The appropriate next physical step would be a failure-discriminating coupon experiment, not the purchase of a 100-interface installation.

Specimens and operation

Build two independently manufactured 25 × 25 mm specimens with 5 × 5 contact islands and the same local geometry.

Each would deposit approximately:

1.306 mg Cu.
3.967 C useful copper charge.

Initial small-array endpoints are 125 N normal, 250 N shear and approximately 0.682 N·m bending. The reduced carrier and edge fields need their own mechanical check; bending moment cannot simply be divided by four.

Run 30 complete cycles per specimen, including unplugged 24-hour holds at cycles 1, 15 and 30.

Controls should include:

A deliberately slow steel/copper process.
The prepared mechanical attachment.
An electrically continuous but deliberately undergrown seam.
No-current and no-copper-ion blanks.
A blocked flow sector.
Known misregistration.
Incomplete stripping.
Measurements

Use one common AC meter for the supply, pump, valves, drying, heater, controller and dedicated proof/unload equipment. Record terminal

Measure:

Liquid mass, flow, pressure and temperature.
Copper transfer and bath concentration.
Cu, Ni and Ir release.
Acid, phosphate and sulfate inventories.
Mask damage and organic leachables.
Local height and width before and after reset.
Fracture location and internal voids.
Force, displacement, rotation and release-port force.
All preparation, cleaning, rejected attempts and destructive samples.

Target calibrated expanded uncertainties of ≤0.5% force, ≤2 µm displacement, ≤0.2 N release force and ≤2% electrical energy. These are procurement requirements, not assumed instrument performance.

With a Cu blank limit of 1 µg per cycle, the expected 1.306 mg transfer is approximately 1,300 times that blank. That makes metal transfer readily distinguishable; it does not establish structural joining.

Numerical gates

The experiment must meet all of the following simultaneously before progressing:

Each stage ≤120 s.
Release ≤20 N.
Full assigned reference load for 24 hours unplugged.
Displacement ≤0.2 mm and rotation ≤0.5°.
No false acceptance of the intentionally weak seam.
No unacceptable seed or mask loss.
≤0.2 µm irreversible contact-plane drift over the 30-cycle test.
Complete stock restoration within assay unc
